quests.description: After drinking the spring water you found for her and recovering her voice, the fiery flower named "Blazing Heart" sends you and the others to the hall of music. The city in the mirage is strikingly similar to Liyue Harbor...

Plants and instruments, melodies and memories, old acquaintances and her hometown... All of them constitute a crucial part of Xinyan's music. There must be some reason that her mirage has shown up on this special island.
Fischl has not yet returned, so the party decides to explore the island first to confirm if there is indeed a mirage here as the divination result indicated, and to whom it belongs.

A lofty castle, an unforgettable tale... This must be Fischl's imagined world. Her mirage is so amazing that every visitor is deeply impressed. However, a mesmerizing dream does not come without a price, just as beautiful flowers often bloom among thistles and thorns...
There is another Fischl here — born from the darkness, she dominates everything in Immernachtreich. Can fear and cowardice devour souls? Which one of the two Prinzessinnen shall triumph in the end?
Without the need for further divination, everyone heads to the final island in search of the next mirage.

Talking to herself, Mona is lost in some old memories. Mona has a unique understanding of Astrology. She believes in fate regardless of how others think. With this belief in her heart, she leads everyone to explore the mirage...

The vast expanse of the starry sky extends endlessly into the distance, with many a fate hidden within. It is simply fascinating: The beautiful sky stands silently in the mirage, its bosom wide and vast, its very existence ancient and gentle, as if it was born to embrace fate and grace everyone with its compassion. Mona understands fate in a way similar to this starry sky.

The boundary between medicine and poison seems to have blurred, as has the line between life and death... Where can one find a truly perfect remedy, or does it exist at all?

Sorush's training continues. Even a Wenut crystallized across countless eras has a date of expiry. Could there possibly be an ode or poem that could outlast even such a being?
After speaking of Mihir and the Oceanids, Sorush seemed to be at a loss. Zurvan's training has now progressed beyond its midpoint...
Sorush has finally realized that, at some point, she walked down a path of meaninglessness and absurdity. The training is approaching its conclusion...
The training is approaching its conclusion. Zurvan's approval is but a step away...
It's time to go home, and enjoy some time with family.
